metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2023 · 20 Days in Mariupol
metas.description: An AP team of Ukrainian journalists trapped in the besieged city of Mariupol struggle to continue their work documenting atrocities of the Russian invasion.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · 2000 Meters to Andriivka
metas.description: Amid the failing counteroffensive, a journalist follows a Ukrainian platoon on their mission to traverse one mile of heavily fortified forest and liberate a strategic village from Russian occupation. But the farther they advance through their destroyed homeland, the more they realize that this war may never end.
